gates.pass: All formatting, lint and manifest checks exit successfully.
gates.fail: Any lint error or unverifiable required source.

gates.pass: All discovered unit suites pass with no skipped mandatory suite.
gates.fail: Any unit failure or missing mandatory service suite.

gates.pass: Service, database and messaging integrations pass with bounded retries.
gates.fail: Any failed integration, retry exhaustion or inconsistent outbox result.

gates.pass: Contracts, schemas, auth, idempotency and API error semantics pass.
gates.fail: Any contract regression, unauthorized access or invalid API behavior.

gates.pass: No secret and no unaccepted CRITICAL/HIGH vulnerability or IaC finding.
gates.fail: Secret detected, signature invalid, or blocking security finding.

gates.pass: Authorized synthetic identity, fraud and abuse scenarios are blocked and audited.
gates.fail: Bypass, replay, cross-tenant access, missing audit or unsafe recovery flow.

gates.pass: SBOM, provenance, immutable digest, Cosign signature and verification pass.
gates.fail: Mutable image, missing SBOM/provenance, invalid signature or untrusted registry.

gates.pass: Configured p95, p99, error-rate, throughput and saturation thresholds pass.
gates.fail: Any mandatory latency, error-rate, throughput or resource threshold fails.

gates.pass: Authorized integration load profile completes within configured SLO thresholds.
gates.fail: Threshold failure, uncontrolled saturation or invalid test environment.

gates.pass: Runbooks, rollback, observability, security and resilience evidence are complete.
gates.fail: Missing evidence, unowned risk, unavailable rollback or unresolved blocker.

gates.pass: All prior immutable artifacts pass and the desired-state Git promotion is approved.
gates.fail: Any missing/failed artifact, digest mismatch or unapproved Git promotion.
